name: B10-0466/2025 (Renew) – Polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It asks Serbia to hold a fair, independent investigation into the Novi Sad station roof collapse that killed 16 people. It asks Serbia to stop using violence, arrests and surveillance against peaceful protesters, and to respect free speech and the right to gather. It also asks the European Union to put pressure on Serbia, and to reconsider its financial support if democratic standards keep slipping.

- The Parliament asks Serbia to investigate the tragedy and release detained protesters; no law changes yet.
- It affects Serbia's government, protesters, journalists and the European Union's funding decisions.
- Next, the Parliament sends its demands to the European Union and Serbian authorities.
